commits.subject: Make OpenAI service-error embedding fixtures version independent
Make OpenAI service-error embedding fixtures version independent

diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status gate, not an independent source failure. Its log executes exit 1. The frozen reusable-pr-build.yml gate fails whenever needs.test-latest-deps.result is not success, and testLatestDeps0 is the only failed upstream check in the exact-head evidence. The same ServiceErrorTest fixture correction resolves its cause; no workflow modification or rerun is warranted.

All 79 assertion failures are new ServiceErrorTest embedding cases rejecting the unexpected gen_ai.request.encoding_formats attribute. Newer SDKs populate base64 by default, as the existing AbstractEmbeddingsTest already documents and handles; error.type itself is correct in the frozen exported spans. Repeated assertion waits and retries culminate in the test-task timeout. Set encodingFormat(BASE64) explicitly in the error-test fixture and assert [base64] only for embedding spans. This gives deterministic exact assertions for minimum and latest SDKs without weakening checks or changing production behavior. Both full library suites pass with both dependency selections after the change.

Use structured provider error codes for `error.type` on chat and embeddings spans and operation-duration metrics, for example `context_length_exceeded` instead of `com.openai.errors.BadRequestException`.

- **Classification:** Report any nonblank provider code verbatim, including codes from OpenAI-compatible services. Retain exception-class fallback for transport failures and missing, blank, or malformed codes; never classify from messages.
- **Scope:** Cover sync/async calls, streaming request failures, and existing async SSE terminal callbacks. Leave lifecycle, status, and cancellation policies unchanged; exclude Responses API errors and blocking SSE iteration failures.
